claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 August 1866, p. 1, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Moravian from Liverpool on the 26th
ultimo, via Londonderry on the 27th, arrived off Father
Point last evening. Her advices are five days later than
those received by the China, and published in the
HERALD on Tuesday morning last.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 August 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
By the steamship Moravian, from Liverpool on the
26th[?] and Londonderry on the 27th ult., we are furnished
with news five days later than by the preceding steamer,
although five days anterior to the latest cable despatches.
